verdict.rationale: Kling's own marketing says users can "generate multiple versions at once" and "batch-produce videos," and that Skills produce assets "all generated in parallel." That is first-party batch generation, but only as one-line homepage claims, with no documented batch API, limits, or workflow details. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API or job mechanics, bulk operations beyond generation (e.g., bulk edit, download or delete across items), stated limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Generate multiple versions at once to test styles, batch-produce videos, and automate the entire production process.
Use dedicated Skills to create storyboards, posters, e-commerce assets, and more—all generated in parallel.
